How Many Bags of Mulch in a Cubic Yard?

One cubic yard equals 27 cubic feet. A standard 2 cubic foot bag of mulch gives you exactly 13.5 bags per cubic yard — round up to 14 when ordering.

## The answer **1 cubic yard = 13.5 bags of 2 cu ft mulch** This comes from a simple conversion: 1 cubic yard = 27 cubic feet. Divide by the bag size: > 27 cu ft ÷ 2 cu ft per bag = **13.5 bags** Since you cannot buy half a bag, always round up to **14 bags** when purchasing. ## Conversion table: bags per cubic yard by bag size | Bag size | Bags per cubic yard | |----------|-------------------| | 2 cu ft (standard) | **13.5 bags** → order 14 | | 3 cu ft | **9 bags** | | 1.5 cu ft | **18 bags** | ## How many cubic yards is a certain number of bags? | Bags (2 cu ft) | Cubic yards | |----------------|-------------| | 5 bags | 0.37 cu yd | | 10 bags | 0.74 cu yd | | 14 bags | 1.04 cu yd | | 27 bags | 2.00 cu yd | | 54 bags | 4.00 cu yd | ## When to buy bags vs. bulk - **Bags:** Best for under 1.5 cu yd, tight-access locations, or exact color matching. - **Bulk delivery:** Best for over 1.5–2 cubic yards. A cubic yard of bulk mulch costs roughly the same as 10–12 bags — saving you 20–40%. Frequently Asked Questions

How many 2 cubic foot bags of mulch are in a cubic yard?

There are exactly 13.5 bags of 2 cubic foot mulch in one cubic yard. Since you cannot buy half a bag, round up to 14 bags when ordering.

How many 3 cubic foot bags of mulch per yard?

There are 9 bags of 3 cubic foot mulch per cubic yard (27 ÷ 3 = 9). Three-cubic-foot bags are less common but available at some stores.

Is bulk mulch cheaper than bags?

Yes — bulk mulch delivered by the yard is almost always cheaper per cubic yard than buying individual bags, especially for orders over 2 cubic yards. The savings can be 40–60% for large orders.

How much does a cubic yard of mulch weigh?

A cubic yard of mulch weighs roughly 400–800 lbs depending on the type and moisture content. Shredded hardwood mulch is heavier than pine bark.
